mapper.select: SELECT u2.ID, u2.FILE_NAME,u1.LE as LEVEL,u2.PARENT_ID,u2.CREATE_TIME,u2.FILE_PATH FROM( SELECT @ids AS p_ids, (SELECT @ids := GROUP_CONCAT(ID) FROM PAN_USER_FILE WHERE FIND_IN_SET(PARENT_ID, @ids)) AS c_ids, @l := @l+1 AS LE FROM PAN_USER_FILE, (SELECT @ids := ${id}, @l := 0 ) b WHERE @ids IS NOT NULL ) u1 JOIN PAN_USER_FILE u2 ON FIND_IN_SET(u2.ID, u1.p_ids) AND IS_DIR = 1
SELECT SUM(b.FILE_SIZE) FROM PAN_USER_FILE a LEFT JOIN PAN_FILE b ON a.FILE_ID = b.ID WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
select * from PAN_USER_FILE where (FILE_PATH = #{filePath} or FILE_PATH like concat(#{filePath},'/%')) and USER_ID = #{userId} and DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'
mapper.update: update PAN_USER_FILE set DELETE_FLAG = "DELETED" ,DELETE_BATCH_NUM = #{userFile.deleteBatchNum},DELETE_TIME= #{userFile.deleteTime}, UPDATE_USER = #{userFile.updateUser},UPDATE_TIME= #{userFile.updateTime} where ID = #{userFile.id}
